title: DOW-UAP-D085_Transmission-of-CIA-Scientific-Advisory-Panel-Rept_1953
what_is_it: A transmittal document forwarding the CIA's 1953 Scientific Advisory Panel report on unidentified flying objects to the Secretary of Defense.
interpretation_warnings: No text was extractable from the PDF — the document is likely a scanned image with poor OCR quality.
All facts are derived solely from the file metadata and CSV description provided by war.gov, not from the document body itself.
The actual findings and recommendations of the Scientific Panel cannot be confirmed from this source alone.
This is likely related to the Robertson Panel (officially the Scientific Advisory Panel on UFOs), a well-known 1953 CIA-convened review.
